component_boundaries.responsibility: Own the accepted three-region vertical workspace shell and composition slots without claiming a consuming-project native component identity.
component_boundaries.reuse_semantics: LOGICAL_BOUNDARY_ONLY; bind a project-native implementation only when consuming-project evidence exists.

component_boundaries.responsibility: Own accepted split-pane and responsive navigation mechanics without changing Cloak-owned hierarchy.
Own the action-palette integration role without inventing a project-native path or component identity.

responsive_engineering.strategy: Preserve desktop horizontal split; below 1024px use the accepted drawer behavior and breakpoint-specific content flow rather than generic stacking.
Preserve accepted mobile single-column content flow and drawer overlay behavior.

composition_ownership.strategy: Grid shell with fixed header, flexible primary workspace, and docked bottom tray.
Header sub-layout owns breadcrumb/action grouping while emphasis remains Cloak-owned.
Responsive container owns split and drawer mechanics without changing accepted visible intent.

layer_relationships.relationship: Own overlay portal and stacking context above shell surfaces while preserving focus and escape lifecycle.
Own drawer mount/unmount, focus containment, and pointer interception only at accepted responsive states.

data_flow_boundaries.contract: Repository/workspace context enters through an explicit input boundary; transport details do not determine visible design.
Active document identity/content is state input; presentation remains bounded by the accepted handoff.

reusable_component_strategy.reason: The handoff supplies a semantic action-palette role but explicitly does not supply a project-native component path.
Use project-native shell/layout primitives only after consuming-project evidence binds their identity and proves fidelity compatibility.

integration_boundaries.rule: Clockwork consumes accepted visible intent and exact handoff content identity without mutating it.
Provides engineering boundaries only; implementation remains Ponytail-owned and separately authorized.

preserve: Preserve every accepted UIEF-4 macro-composition identity in composition_ownership.
Preserve accepted responsive transformations without replacing them with generic stacking.
Preserve Cloak ownership of visible intent, hierarchy, spacing, typography, interactions, and accessibility requirements.
Preserve project-native component/token/asset precedence only when traceable consuming-project evidence exists.
unresolved_engineering_questions: Consuming-project native component, icon, and design-token identities remain unresolved until accepted project evidence binds them.
